author: ETA PRIME
description:
Lenovo says a SteamOS-powered Legion Go 2 is coming (targeting June), but there’s nothing stopping you from installing official SteamOS right now. In this quick test, I’m running SteamOS 3.9 (Steam Deck Beta branch) on the Ryzen Z2 Extreme model with 32GB RAM, and I’ve dedicated 16GB to the iGPU in BIOS (Radeon 890). Most features work out of the box—including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, haptics, and desktop mode—while RGB control is the big missing piece (for now).
